edges.description: Model edges chained into one polyline (or spot points), as terrain.create_from_edges

elevation.description: A contour's elevation when points have no Z (model Z)

level.description: Promote the display contour at this model Z to a source contour

points.description: Model points [x, y, z] (or [x, y] for a contour with an elevation); a closed polyline repeats its first point

amount.description: raise: metres at full weight, not 0 (negative lowers)

falloff.description: Weight from 1 at the path or inside the region to 0 at the radius or falloff width; default smooth

falloffWidth.description: Plan metres outside the region over which the weight falls to 0; default 0

mode.description: raise (a negative amount lowers; "Sculpt terrain") or smooth ("Smooth terrain")

path.description: Brush stroke as model [x, y]; a click is one point. The stroke is swept: each vertex moves once, by its distance to the whole path

region.description: Closed polygon as model [x, y] (at most 20,000 corners; a last point repeating the first is dropped)

strength.description: smooth: the step toward the neighbours' mean per iteration; default 0.5

cutSlope.description: Rise over run where the pad is below the ground; default 0.5 (1:2)

elevation.description: Pad elevation (model Z, metres); default the footprint's own height

fillSlope.description: Rise over run where the pad is above the ground; default 0.5 (1:2)

footprint.description: {body, face}: a horizontal face; {body}: the lowest horizontal face of a group, component or body; {edges}: model edges of one closed loop; {polygon}: model points [x, y] or [x, y, z] (at most 20,000, simple, no holes)

maxDistance.description: Plan metres a grading ray may run before it daylights; default 100

mode.description: daylight (default): cut and fill slopes to the ground; width: a band of fixed width

width.description: mode width: the band's plan width in metres

context.description: overlay: the group the new group goes in (the active context); 0 or omitted for the model

edges.description: Model edges and curves {body, edge} in any context, projected vertically; chained as terrain.create_from_edges chains them

faces.description: Model faces {body, face} in any context; every loop is draped

lift.description: overlay: metres above the surface; default 0.01

mode.description: imprint: split the terrain's triangles along the lines (shape unchanged) and keep them as breaklines; overlay: ordinary geometry in a new group, terrain unchanged

paintRegions.description: imprint: paint the terrain inside each face with the face's material, on every rebuild too

edit.description: ID of a recorded pad (stamp) change; the list is replayed

restamp.description: Re-read the footprint from the pad's source body

contourInterval.description: Metres between contour lines; every fifth is an index line

contours.description: Draw contour lines (derived display, not geometry)

shading.description: Shade by the tiles' material or by ten elevation bands
